pylons_vi: 2 tháp bê tông trắng hình chữ A theo phương dọc cầu (một thân thon giữa dải phân cách, chân tách trước – sau), cao ≈27,5 m trên mặt cầu, 72 m từ mặt nước; dây văng đỏ một mặt phẳng
pylons_en: 2 white concrete pylons, an A along the bridge axis (one tapered median shaft with fore-and-aft legs), ≈27.5 m above the deck, 72 m above the water; one central plane of red stays

model3d.notes: Main unit 120 + 218 + 120 m (T25–T28; pylons on T26/T27), extradosed PSC box girder, haunched (≈9.5 m deep at the pylons, ≈4 m at mid-span; drawn with deck_haunch, G17), deck 23.5 m on the main unit (20 m elsewhere), 4 lanes. Navigation clearance 40 m (5,000 DWT). Pylons: 'A along the bridge axis' — a single tapered concrete shaft in the median, splitting into two legs fore-and-aft with a ≈3 × 4.6 m opening at deck level (≈5 m to the chamfered top), ≈27.5 m above the deck to the concrete tip (+≈3 m lightning mast); 72 m from the water to the tip (press). Press quotes 32 m (Tiền Phong / Đạt Phương) and 34 m (Người Quan Sát) for the pylon; two side photos give pylon : deck-above-water ≈ 0.6, which with the 72 m total puts the deck at ≈44.4 m at the pylons and the pylon at ≈27.5 m. One central plane of 17 red stays per side (34 per pylon, Người Quan Sát), anchored in the pylon over 6.9–20.1 m and on the median from 26 to 89 m from the pylon (≈40 m of the main span unstayed). Below the deck twin wall piers (longitudinal pair) on an octagonal cap of 34 Ø2 m bored piles (83.7 m). Deck ≈40.5 m above water at the unit ends, ≈44.4 m at the pylons, ≈45.5 m at mid-span.

pylon_custom.description: 'Chữ A theo phương dọc cầu': each pylon is one tapered concrete shaft on the bridge centreline (median). Seen from the side it is an A: two legs fore and aft (x ≈ ±3.1 m at the deck, 3.0 m thick along the bridge, 3.4 m wide across) lean in to a narrow tip 27.5 m above the deck, with a 3 × 4.6 m opening at deck level; above the opening the shaft is solid. Seen along the bridge it is a narrow 3.4 → 2.6 m column. One central plane of red semi-fan stays anchors in the main-side and back-side faces. Below the deck, twin longitudinal wall piers (5 m along the bridge × 8 m across, 1.5 m apart) stand on an octagonal pile cap ≈30 × 22 m whose top is ≈4.2 m above the water.

notes: r10 (brief-r10-thuan-an.md): longitudinal A median shaft, twin wall piers on a pile cap, 17 semi-fan stays per side 26–89 m (G15), haunched girder (G17). Photos: Tiền Phong, VnExpress, Dân Việt / Người Quan Sát, Báo Lâm Đồng (7/2026).
colour: white pylons and deck; red stays
